source_refs.note: Topic 4.1.3 Using Stacks in Computers (PDF 97, printed 94). 'Stacks' prints as 'Sacks'.

blocks.text: Sacks are used to evaluate expressions, function call management, balancing parentheses and undo mechanism. Let's discuss them one by one.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book prints “Sacks”; it means Stacks.
